TN-2025-SB2537.aiSummary: This law changes the time limit for filing certain property tax exemption applications in Tennessee. It says an application filed within 180 days after the exempt use began can count from that start date if it is filed after May 20 and before the end of the year, for property owned by a religious, charitable, scientific, or nonprofit educational group. It also changes a related filing deadline from 35 days to 45 days.

TN-2025-SB1713.title: State Government - As enacted, requires either the executive head or president of each public institution of higher education, or the chief executive head of any of its campuses to submit an annual attestation of compliance to the comptroller of the treasury no later than January 1, 2027, and each January 1 thereafter, that such entity has not implemented a discriminatory preference to increase diversity, equity, or inclusion; authorizes the attorney general to make certain related investigations. - Amends TCA Title 4; Title 5; Title 6; Title 7 and Title 49.

TN-2025-HB2204.aiSummary: The law requires TACIR, a state research group, to study pay and other benefits for state and local law enforcement officers in Tennessee and to report its findings by January 31, 2027. The study must look at how pay and benefits affect hiring and keeping officers, especially in smaller city and county departments, and at how state pay changes affect local officers.
